title: Make the bounded Rust review gate runnable on Windows
outcome: The mandatory /review-changes Rust gate now invokes scripts/test-rust.sh directly. Native Windows PowerShell and cmd cannot execute the POSIX shebang or ulimit logic, so the workflow is blocked on a P0 platform. Provide a cross-platform launcher or a documented and command-selected Windows fallback that still bounds RUST_TEST_THREADS and preserves caller arguments.
acceptance: The mandatory Rust review gate runs from supported Windows, macOS, and Linux environments; Unix retains the raised-FD behavior where available; Windows uses a compatible bounded-concurrency path; command docs and command-contract tests cover platform selection.
